name: carbon-arc
description: Carbon Arc plugins for competitive, consumer, audience and place intelligence.

plugins.name: carbon-arc-company-intelligence
plugins.description: Analyze companies and brands with Carbon Arc data. Built to keep you in control: iterate and explore as you normally would, or ask it to run straight through. Three reports: competitive insights for strategy teams, an earnings preview for investors, and a category report for small businesses. Try: "Build a competitive insights report on [company]." "Put together an earnings preview for [ticker]." "Where else do [company]'s customers spend?" "Measure the impact of [event] on [company]."

plugins.name: carbon-arc-talent-intelligence
plugins.description: Analyze talent (musicians and actors) with Carbon Arc data. Built to keep you in control: iterate and explore as you normally would, or ask it to run straight through. One report: an audience intelligence brief for talent management, agencies and labels. Try: "Build a brief on [artist or actor]." "Who are [artist]'s real peers?" "Which cities pay the most to see [artist] live?"

plugins.name: carbon-arc-location-intelligence
plugins.description: Analyze venues and metro areas with Carbon Arc data. Built to keep you in control: iterate and explore as you normally would, or ask it to run straight through. Two reports: a venue report for those who run or book arenas, stadiums and theaters, and a place report comparing a metro area with its peers, for market researchers. Try: "Build a venue report on [venue]." "Which shows drive resale prices at [venue]?" "What did [event] do to [city]'s economy?"
